splits: 20 development pictures of Shopfront and Wing; 36 regression pictures of six previously reviewed layouts.

transform.coordinates: native source pixels, origin at upper-left image edge; model pixel (0,0) center is (+0.5,+0.5) before inverse resize

junctions.algorithm: midpoints of nearby nonparallel segment endpoints

deeplsd.inference_timing: resize + CNN + official PyTLSD extraction/filter + coordinate conversion and junctions; excludes loading, image decode and cache writing

scalelsd.timing: Synchronized model forward only, once per unique image. Model loading, IO and one additional transform self-test excluded.
scalelsd.transform_check: Re-ran first frame with 512x512 output metadata and verified every native x/y coordinate independently.

mlsd.preprocessing: Pillow BOX resize to 512 square, float32 RGB plus 1.0 alpha

strips.units: Surface-mask pixels, normalized within-image inverse depth; native RGB on 0-255

settings.rule: Choose each input on development, preferring a higher layout-average F1 for walls, and more undersides for strips if F1 stays within 0.01 of the control. Ties prefer fewer unpaired proposals and the first listed input. For an ordinary surface default require more matches and higher F1 on both development and regression, no fewer undersides on either, opening fill increasing at most 0.003, and correctly assigned pixel fraction dropping at most 0.002 on either. Keep comparably scored experimental methods opt-in until their ordinary image entry point is verified.

runtime.note: Per-method time summed across pictures under concurrent load. Original raw line, normal and Depth Anything inference was reused.
